NQ.es: giro alcista del viernes muerto en Asia: cerro bajo 29278 (su invalidacion) y quedo en balance 28981-29111 todo el dia. Corto de dia 1 reabierto, conviccion baja -- vigila si Londres resuelve el balance o repite el patron de shock-resuelve-marco por 3a vez.
NQ.en: Friday's bullish turn died in Asia: closed below 29278 (its invalidation) and sat in a 28981-29111 balance all day. Day-1 short reopened, low conviction -- watch whether London resolves the balance or repeats the shock-resolves-frame pattern for a 3rd time.

ES.es: cerro Asia a solo 2.5pts bajo su invalidacion (7626) tras tocar ambos lados -- corto de dia 1 reabierto pero muy fragil, genuina moneda al aire. El fade B en el cluster VAH/FVG 7624-7629 es la zona mas cercana al precio del bus.
ES.en: closed Asia just 2.5pts below its invalidation (7626) after tagging both sides -- day-1 short reopened but very fragile, a genuine coin flip. The B fade at the VAH/FVG cluster 7624-7629 is the closest-to-price zone on the bus.

GC.es: sin cambios de fondo: sigue dentro de su propia zona de no-trade (POC/eq), command en NO-TRADE CHOP explicito. El marco diario/semanal por fin se alineo a la baja. El golden 4432-4453 sigue de referencia (R-GC-golden-eventual-tag) pero inalcanzable hoy.
GC.en: no change to the underlying picture: still inside its own no-trade zone (POC/eq), command explicitly reads NO-TRADE CHOP. The daily/weekly frame finally aligned to the downside. The 4432-4453 golden zone stays as reference (R-GC-golden-eventual-tag) but unreachable today.

YM.es: el mejor recuperado de los 3 indices: reclamo casi todo el gap, cotiza a 15pts del cierre del viernes. A+ tactica justo bajo precio (POC/EMA 52535-52546), pero marco diario propio de YM sigue sin confirmar y command sin dar permiso.
YM.en: the best recovered of the 3 indices: reclaimed almost the whole gap, trades 15pts from Friday's close. A+ tactical right under price (POC/EMA 52535-52546), but YM's own daily frame still hasn't confirmed and command isn't granting permission.

CL.es: la bisagra se resolvio con fuerza a favor del largo (reclamo + ruptura + nuevo maximo del ciclo en 104.46); hoy corrige dentro de esa tendencia. A+ tactica justo en precio (101.43-102.07), la confluencia mas limpia del bus, bloqueada solo por permiso de sesion.
CL.en: the pivot resolved with real strength in favor of the long (reclaim + break + fresh cycle high at 104.46); today it's correcting inside that trend. A+ tactical right at price (101.43-102.07), the bus's cleanest confluence, blocked only by session permission.
